SensitivityDeclaration.description: Sensitivity information used for de-identification and routing. Use terms, access tier and date policy come from the source register. The contains* flags apply to every file unless the file overrides them or its class fixes the flag or gives a default (the class annotations in data.yaml). A contains* flag that nothing sets is unknown and treated as true. A missing synthetic flag is treated as false.

containsBiometricIdentifiers.description: The data includes biometric identifiers, full-face images, voice or similar content. Such files never leave INTAKE: they are not loaded into the normalized store or released. HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers (P), biometric identifiers including finger and voice prints, and (Q), full-face photographs and comparable images, 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i).

containsDates.description: The data includes dates more precise than a year. These are accepted at deposit and masked at release. HIPAA Safe Harbor identifier (C), 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(C), which also covers ages over 89.

containsFreeText.description: The data includes unstructured text that needs a de-identification scan. Not a HIPAA Safe Harbor identifier itself: free text can contain any of them.

containsZipCodes.description: The data includes postal codes. These are accepted at deposit and masked at release. Part of HIPAA Safe Harbor identifier (B), 45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)(B), which covers all geographic subdivisions smaller than a state; this flag covers postal codes only.

directIdentifiersRemoved.description: The contributor confirms that the HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers the contains* flags do not declare were removed before upload: (A) and (D) to (O), such as names, contact details, record, account and device numbers, and (R), any other unique identifying number, characteristic or code (45 CFR 164.514(b)(2)(i)). Dates (C), postal codes (B), biometric identifiers (P) and full-face images (Q) are declared with the flags instead. Must be true for non-synthetic data.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the sensitivity values.

synthetic.description: The batch contains synthetic data with no real people. Identifier checks become warnings.

@context.description: The JSON-LD context: Croissant 1.1's context plus the RDDC terms, embedded as an object (schema/generated/rddc_sidecar.context.jsonld).

@id.description: The sidecar ID, urn:uuid:<uuid>.

@type.description: The JSON-LD type. cr:FileObject or cr:FileSet for distribution items.

batchId.description: Contributor-assigned batch ID, unique within the source.

conformsTo.description: Specifications the document conforms to. Must include http://mlcommons.org/croissant/1.1 and https://w3id.org/rddc/sidecar/<schema version>.

contributorContact.description: Email address of the contributor's contact for the batch or source.

distribution.description: All files and file sets in the batch, listed inline. Large batches still use one document, which consumers can stream. A measured 120,000-file C-CDA batch produced about 93 MB of JSON.

name.description: Human-readable batch name, by convention "<sourceId>/<batchId>".

noticeRef.description: Reference to a GOVERN withdrawal or restriction notice. The notice holds the terms and legal details.

recordSet.description: Record sets describing the records in the batch's files.

registerVersion.description: The source register version used to issue the descriptor or draft the sidecar.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity information for the batch or file. File-level contains* flags override the batch values.

sourceId.description: The source register ID. Must match the source the upload's delivery role is registered for.

subjects.description: The subject table, listed inline. It may be empty only for an add batch whose data files are all DocumentationFiles (modality metadata). The RDDC validator checks this rule.

temporalCoverage.description: The period the data covers, as an ISO 8601 date or interval "start/end", e.g. "2019/2024" or "2024-03/2024-06"; ".." leaves one end open, e.g. "2021/..". Use year or month precision unless the batch declares containsDates: day-precision dates for a set about one subject can identify them.

url.description: S3 URL of the batch prefix, ending with a slash. The sidecar sits directly under it.
